notes.title: Big Trouble In Little Chimney is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
I'm really excited to announce that the [b]Big Trouble In Little Chimney[/b] is OUT NOW!

Grab your Shotgun, finish your hot punch and don't forget your mission: Save the Christmas! 🎄

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3072710/Big_Trouble_in_Little_Chimney/

Even though the game is finished, I will continue to gather your suggestions to improve the game. If anyone has ideas about what they'd like to see, I'd love to hear them.

Thank you to everyone who supported me and my game during the development. Thanks for all your suggestions and feedback, you're all awesome!

And special thanks to my lovely wife Silvia for her GREAT patience :)

Have fun, folks!

@FobTi

notes.title: My NEW game is coming soon!
notes.notes:
Hi folks!

The Steam page for my new game "Big Trouble in Little Chimney" is now live! 🥳

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3072710/Big_Trouble_in_Little_Chimney/

Krampus is Coming! Grab your shotgun, finish your hot punch and don't forget your mission: Save the Christmas! Big Trouble in Little Chimney is highly-addictive and fast paced arena bullet-hell shooter.

If you like what you see, please, add the game to your wishlist ✅

Cheers,
FobTi

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - September 27, 2021
notes.notes:
[h2]The following updates have been implemented:[/h2]


[b]Fixed[/b]: Murky Achievement

[b]Fixed[/b]: Steam Overlay + F12 Screenshot problem.

[b]Added[/b]: Selectable stage theme (Grassy, Muddy, Snowy or Random) You can find it at the bottom of the screen on the MODE SELECT.


Big Thanks to [b]Antoine G. @__sleepingpanda[/b] for help with Steam Overlay problem and [b]Baltus[/b] for bugs report.


Happy gaming! :)

@FobTi
